name: Sakhi Niwas - Working Women Hostel
department: Ministry of Women and Child Development
target_group: Working women, including eligible women needing safe accommodation
eligibility: Admission is subject to availability and the applicable Sakhi Niwas guidelines.
benefits: Safe and conveniently located accommodation for eligible working women; facilities/services depend on the centre.
documents: Employment/income proof as required by the centre
Other documents prescribed by the implementing authority
application_process: Apply/contact the concerned Sakhi Niwas or implementing authority.
source: Ministry of Women and Child Development / Government of India
